name: open_drawer_stall_detect
code:
def primitive(obj, target, p):
    handle = obj['parts']['handle']
    front = obj['parts']['front']
    
    # Grasp the handle using the part-level primitive
    success = grasp_part(
        handle,
        approach=p['approach_dist'],
        height=p['grasp_height_offset'],
        depth=p['grasp_depth'],
        force=p['grasp_force'],
        from_above=0
    )
    
    if not success:
        return False
    
    wait(0.3)
    
    # Pull along the front normal until the drawer stalls at its limit
    front_normal = front['normal']
    dx = front_normal[0]
    dy = front_normal[1]
    
    result = move_linear(
        dx, dy, dz=p['pull_height_change'],
        dist=p['max_pull_dist'],
        speed=p['pull_speed'],
        until_stall=1,
        stall_lag=p['stall_lag']
    )
    
    wait(0.2)
    
    # Release the handle
    release()
    wait(0.2)
    
    # Retreat
    retreat(dz=p['retreat_height'])
    
    return True
description: Grasp the handle with the part-level grasp primitive, then use move_linear with stall detection to pull the drawer out. The motion automatically stops when the drawer reaches its travel limit (whether 9 cm or 12 cm), preventing over-pull that could cause the grip to slip or push the drawer back.
check: look() shows the drawer's front has moved outward by at least 8 cm from its initial position

approach_dist.meaning: distance to approach from along handle normal before grasping

grasp_height_offset.meaning: vertical offset from handle center when grasping

grasp_depth.meaning: how far to reach into the object when grasping handle

grasp_force.meaning: gripper force when holding the handle

pull_height_change.meaning: vertical movement during pull (positive = lift slightly)

max_pull_dist.meaning: maximum pull distance; motion stops early when drawer stalls

pull_speed.meaning: speed of pulling motion in m/s

stall_lag.meaning: lag threshold to detect when drawer has reached its limit

retreat_height.meaning: how high to lift hand after releasing
